The judgment passed by this Court dated 29.08.2023 is yet to be complied with by the respondents.

In the Status Report dated 13th November, 2024 filed by the Chief Engineer (Electric)
Distribution, JKPDCL, Jammu, it is submitted that the indent for acquisition of 6 kanals and 15 marlas of land at Gladni, Grid Station Complex, Narwal, Jammu has been submitted to the Collector Land Acquisition, 220 KV, PDD, JKPTCL, Jammu for further necessary action.

The communication dated 12th November, 2024 placed on record along with the status report does not clearly indicate that the requisite funds have been made available to the Collector Land Acquisition to proceed in the matter.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner, however, brings to our notice a communication of the Collector Land Acquisition concerned dated 16th November, 2024, whereby the indent issued by the Chief Engineer has been sent back with the observation that the same is required to be rooted through the Administrative Secretary or its authorized representative of the department concerned.
A communication dated 16th November, 2024, which is passed on by the learned counsel for the petitioner, is taken on record.
3. From the above, it seems that no substantial steps have been taken by the respondents to comply with the judgment.
4. In the circumstances, we are left with no other option but to presume that the respondents are not serious in implementing the judgment passed by this Court.
However, on the request of learned counsel appearing for the respondents, one last opportunity is granted to come up with the complete compliance of the judgment.

The Chief Engineer shall ensure that the requisite indent through the Administrative Secretary is placed with the Collector Land Acquisition within a period of three weeks from today and on receipt of the indent along with requisite administrative cost of acquisition of land etc., the Collector shall proceed to issue Notification under Section 11 (1) of the Jammu and Kashmir Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and complete the proceedings within the statutory period.

sentences.text: We make it clear that in case there is failure on the part of either of the respondents, we shall be constrained to secure their personal presence and initiate the contempt proceedings against them.
